metadata.description: Personal Claude Code mods: usage meters, image previews and other HUD tweaks for the terminal

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Context, session and weekly usage bars at the bottom right of the prompt footer, like the desktop app

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: A preview of the image in the clipboard and thumbnails of the images pasted into the prompt, drawn above the prompt in any terminal
